recap.text: Donut's platinum quest box holds a skill potion and a pair of fang caps, as her last one did. She drinks the potion, raising Animal Wrangling by three points to eight. The caps add fifteen percent movement speed and fifteen percent strength to Mongo, the level-29 dinosaur; his last pair gave poison and paralysis that seldom fire, since whatever he chomps is usually dead already. Carl fits them to his teeth, after fishing out a little piece of robot Donut.

beats.headline: Same box, new caps
beats.text: Donut's platinum quest box holds what her last one did: a skill potion and a pair of fang caps. She drinks the potion, three more points of Animal Wrangling, up to eight. The last caps gave Mongo a damage buff and poison and paralysis that seldom fire, because whatever he chomps is usually dead already. These add fifteen percent movement speed and fifteen percent strength to the level-29 dinosaur. Once again Donut makes Carl fit them to his teeth, and first he has to fish out a little piece of robot Donut.
beats.gist: Donut's quest box holds another skill potion and fang caps, adding fifteen percent speed and strength to Mongo.
